people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Joab was told, “Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.”
translations.bsb: Then it was reported to Joab, “The king is weeping and mourning over Absalom.”
translations.kjv: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.
translations.asv: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.
